numbering: life/examples steps are zero-based steps[n], matching apply-rulings.ts; outline frame is act 0 and numbered acts retain their numbers

rulings.barItem: published requests replayed as published through the pinned client; correct credential for the act; every published example of served operations
rulings.finding: The pinned SDK Sandbox.create defaults secure:true and allow_internet_access:true. The quickstart create lacks those fields and never captures/passes its envdAccessToken, unlike its published SDK calls. The pinned files.list sends depth:1. Its single write uses filename /path/to/file. The cited read-write page also publishes the multiple-file write for served post_files, but there is no doc-example or replay for it.
rulings.source: https://docs.e2b.dev/quickstart; https://docs.e2b.dev/filesystem/read-write (Writing single files and Writing multiple files); https://registry.npmjs.org/e2b/-/e2b-2.45.0.tgz dist/index.mjs:4970-4971,1942-1951,1890-1895
rulings.requiredChanges: Steps 4 and 11 must include secure:true and allow_internet_access:true in their SDK-translated create bodies. Step 4 must capture envdAccessToken, and steps 5,6,7,8 must send it as X-Access-Token. Step 6 must send depth:1. Step 7 must use the SDK filename /path/to/file for its real multipart bytes. Immediately after original step 7 add the published multiple-file write example: one multipart POST /files with two file fields named file and filenames /path/to/a and /another/path/to/b, both carrying the published file content bytes. Add read-effect steps for both uploaded files; assert supplied paths/names/types and read bytes rather than a generated id. Add its sourced doc-examples entry. In original step 1 update the root-list requestText to include depth:1 and add explicit matching fake replies for that multi-file write and both read effects; its upload reply must contain both supplied file paths. These additions are numbered by original step 7 for carry-forward. Update the quickstart doc-examples input to include its actual SDK secure/internet defaults and list input to include depth:1. No other journey steps need change. In original step 3 explicitly enroll envdVersion 0.6.2, as the life does, so the translated SDK requests omit the pre-0.4 default username query/Basic header; include this setup edit in carry-forward. Consequence of the explicit template envdVersion setup: add envdVersion equals 0.6.2 expectations on the create example at original zero-based index 3, paused inventory example at index 12 (0.envdVersion), and connect example at index 13. The inventory and connect indices are included solely for these setup-decided assertions; no other content on those steps is authorized to change.

clarifications.reason: The original mandatory template envdVersion setup decides the returned envdVersion in later example answers. Published-examples requires all setup-decided fields asserted. This clarification includes those downstream assertion edits in the original ruling; no second artifact judgment occurred.
